picks.why: Round, true pumpkin mass with deep carved edges and a classic nose and teeth. It reads instantly; candidate 1 is squatter and has a simpler face.
Small fangs make it a bat at once, and the wings stay well proportioned to the body. The face is the least toy-like of the three.
Base, stem and arms are balanced and sit in one perspective. Candidate 1's base tilts away from the top, and candidate 2's base is oversized.
Matte cast-iron body with plausible riveted ring handles and bubbles kept inside the brew. It has the least floating extras and the handles match, unlike candidate 1.
The stand ring follows the table perspective and carries a single gem. Candidate 3 adds extra gems, and candidate 2's stand is fatter and more cartoonish.
Base follows the lid's shoulder shape, with restrained moulding giving real carpentry depth. The coffin silhouette reads clearest and sits flat on the floor.
Only candidate. A clear cross-carved headstone with believable stone mass, and moss and grass kept modest.
Slim handle with a compact, natural bristle head at true broom proportions. Candidate 2's handle is too thick, and candidate 3's head spreads too wide and low.
Stable house with a crooked but believable structure and fewer add-ons. Candidate 1 leans too far with twin lanterns, and candidate 2 adds hinges, a path and a large lamp.
Fewest leaves and vines, with ground around the group, so it reads as a patch and keeps room like the real card. Candidate 1 is overcrowded and candidate 3 is tighter.
